Hacker News 和 Indie Hackers 通了。Reddit 403——换 old.reddit 和 RSS。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "const targets=[",
 " ['old_reddit_json','https://old.reddit.com/r/sidehustle/top.json?t=year&limit=15'],",
 " ['reddit_rss','https://www.reddit.com/r/sidehustle/top/.rss?t=year'],",
 " ['redditdev_json','https://api.reddit.com/r/sidehustle/top?t=year&limit=15'],",
 " ['producthunt','https://www.producthunt.com/']",
 "];",
 "let i=0;",
 "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
 "async function next(){",
 " if(i>=targets.length) return;",
 " const t=targets[i++];",
 " const pu=new URL(t[1]);",
 " await sleep(i===1?1500:6000);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:t[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json, application/rss+xml, text/html'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',async function(){",
 " const b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
 " console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
 " console.log(b.substring(0,600).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
 " console.log('');",
 " await next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('=== '+t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ov2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ov2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe Reddit alternative endpoints", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));

const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
  "const targets=[",
  "  ['old_reddit_json','https://old.reddit.com/r/sidehustle/top.json?t=year&limit=15'],",
  "  ['reddit_rss','https://www.reddit.com/r/sidehustle/top/.rss?t=year'],",
  "  ['redditdev_json','https://api.reddit.com/r/sidehustle/top?t=year&limit=15'],",
  "  ['producthunt','https://www.producthunt.com/']",
  "];",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=targets.length) return;",
  "  const t=targets[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(t[1]);",
  "  await sleep(i===1?1500:6000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:t[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':'application/json, application/rss+xml, text/html'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      const b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,600).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
  "      console.log('');",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('=== '+t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ov2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-ov2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe Reddit alternative endpoints", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 5000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
